edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender of the internal transfer.
_msgSender is used as spender input in transferFrom.
_msgSender is used as owner input in approve.
setFeeTwo authorises msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet2.
setFeeOne authorises msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualswap authorises msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorises msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
_owner is compared with _msgSender in the onlyOwner modifier.
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping.
cooldown enforcement in _transfer depends on block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is supplied as the router deadline in openTrading.
cooldown mapping is read to gate buys in _transfer.
contract token balance is derived from _rOwned of the contract.
contractTokenBalance is passed into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
tokenAmount parameter drives the router swap call.
amount parameter controls the value moved in _transfer.
from parameter selects the debited account.
to parameter selects the credited account.
sender parameter is debited in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter is credited in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter is expanded into reflection values.
fee parameter overwrites _feeAddr2 in setFeeTwo.
bots_ array entries are written into the bots blacklist.
tFee local is passed into _reflectFee.
tTeam local is passed into _takeTeam.
rAmount local is subtracted from the sender's _rOwned balance.
uniswapV2Router state is used to execute the swap call.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the contract ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the contract ETH.
_rTotal is one of the inputs of _getRate.
_tTotal is one of the inputs of _getRate.
_tFeeTotal accumulates the reflected token fee.
_feeAddr1 is read as the tax fee in _getValues.
_feeAddr2 is read as the team fee in _getValues.
bots blacklist is checked for both from and to.
_isExcludedFromFee is consulted before applying fees and cooldown.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer size on buys.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send path.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown branch.
uniswapV2Pair decides whether the transfer is a buy or a sell.
_owner bypasses blacklist, fee and cooldown checks in _transfer.
transfer forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards execution to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve calls _approve to store the allowance.
_transfer delegates the actual settlement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer performs an external swap before balances are updated.
_transfer sends ETH out before balances are updated.
external calls happen before _rOwned state settlement inside _transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the untrusted external router call.
sendETHToFee performs untrusted external ETH transfers.
openTrading assigns the router instance to uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading makes an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount.
manualswap calls the external swap path directly.
manualsend triggers external ETH transfers directly.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_transferStandard reads values from _getValues.
_transferStandard mutates reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits the contract entry of _rOwned.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal.

setFeeTwo overwrites the _feeAddr2 state variable.
setFeeOne overwrites the _feeAddr1 state variable.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
owner-only setter mutates cooldownEnabled.
renounceOwnership onlyOwner overwrites _owner with address(0).
constructor mints the full reflection supply into _rOwned.
constructor sets the first fee wallet.
constructor sets the second fee wallet.
constructor configures fee exemptions.

the router swap can re-enter _transfer while balances are still unsettled.

normalization_plan.reason: 'from' is only the source-address parameter of _transfer and should be normalised into that function node.
'to' is only the destination-address parameter of _transfer.
'amount' is only the transfer amount parameter of _transfer.
'sender' is a parameter used exclusively inside _transferStandard.
'recipient' is a parameter used exclusively inside _transferStandard.
'tAmount' is the input parameter consumed by _getValues.
'contractTokenBalance' is a local temporary of _transfer feeding the swap.
'contractETHBalance' is a local temporary of _transfer feeding sendETHToFee.
'fee' is the new-value parameter of the fee setters (setFeeTwo/setFeeOne).
'bots_' is the blacklist array parameter of setBots.
'tFee' local is the fee component consumed by _reflectFee.
'tTeam' local is the team component consumed by _takeTeam.
'rAmount' local is the debited reflection amount inside _transferStandard.
